services.desc: Beginning in the 2026-2027 school year, we are requesting a $5 per student educational contribution for school field trips. This contribution supports the Museum's Educational Access Fund and helps expand access to educational programs and resources. The Heritage of the Americas Museum is committed to ensuring that all students have access to meaningful educational experiences.
